name: Arena Rank
tName: Wipe Out Your Opponents and Become No.1
desc: On the second, fourth, sixth day from the server opening, the top 3 players in the arena rank will each get a bonus reward (According to the rank at 19:30 every day in the arena). Meanwhile, every day there will be 5 lucky players, and they will receive a lucky gift. Rewards will be sent by in-game mail.
